objective: Ship a tested beta of Grammarly-style live proofread previews in ByteProof: dashed pink-red underlines, hover popup with track-changes styling, one-click apply, a General-settings toggle, and token efficiency.
acceptance: underlines render under changed words in AX-compatible apps
hover popup shows struck-through old and green new text
clicking a suggestion applies the edit in place
General settings toggle turns the feature on and off
test suite green and installer signed and notarized
nonGoals: changes to the existing Word tracked-changes proofread
